# Sidequest: Dirty Laundry (Meadow Breath Sprayer & Prototype ABX03)

![Sidequest: Dirty Laundry (Meadow Breath Sprayer & Prototype ABX03)](/uploads/588_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update December 14, 2025] New map with smaller symbols

In the new region of Burning Springs, the Abraxodyne company has a lot on its plate, you can find wrecked trucks with chemicals distributed everywhere, the weather changes to "Abraxodyne weather" when a nuke is blown, and Abraxodyne briefcases containing important information are scattered everywhere. In the **side quest “Dirty Laundry”** it is your job to find ALL of these suitcases. For this you will receive a few rewards.

*Quote Bethesda:*

Look for the mysterious Abraxodyne Briefcases throughout Burning Springs. Take them to Bodhi in Athens to complete the “Dirty Laundry” side quest.

Unlike other collectibles, these briefcases only appear once per player in specific locations. You'll have to search every corner to find all 150. (Rumor has it that a 151st suitcase is hidden under a red truck, but we're pretty sure that's made up.)

By turning in the suitcases, you'll help Bodhi solve the mystery of his missing daughter - and earn unique Abraxodyne-style rewards in the process. You'll receive a unique legendary weapon for completing the quest - which only requires you to find about half of the suitcases - but you'll get an even more powerful version if you find them all.

Everywhere in Burning Springs you will find **Abraxodyne information**, these are suitcases with an Abraxodyne print. As soon as you collect one of them or enter the city of Athens, the quest starts automatically.

There are **150 Abraxodyne Information** suitcases. You can only collect each suitcase once per character. You can also find the number of suitcases collected in your **Challenges**. 

### "Dirty Laundry" rewards

After **1** you will receive the **Abraxodyne Briefcase**. (CAMP Decoration > Special)

After **3** you will receive the **Abraxodyne Storage Crate**. (CAMP storage > storage boxes)

After **25** you will receive the **Super Duper Mart Cooler**. (CAMP furniture > shelves)

After **50** you will receive the **Abraxodyne Overall**. (clothes)

After **76** you will receive the **Meadow Breath Sprayer** (Plasma Flamethrower): 

- 1* Anti Armor
- 2* inertia
- 3* durability

After **110** you will receive the **Abraxodyne Headquarters Wall Shield**. (CAMP wall decor > sign)

After **130** you will receive the **Rusty Abraxodyne Shield**. (CAMP decoration > sign)

After **150** you will receive the **Prototype ABX03** (Plasma Flamethrower):

- 1* *-* 3*** like meadow breath sprayer
- 4* The Pyromancer

The weapons cannot be modded, but they are tradable. So if you have sold them or discarded them, you can always buy them again for gold at **Windy in Highway Town**.

### Abraxodyne Hideout

The **Abraxodyne Hideouts** can be opened after Bodhi gives you the codes, they contain:

- 3x Abraxodyne information
- "Encrypted Note"
- Scrap
- a random blueprint.

There are **only 3** Abraxodyne caches:

- Dino Peaks Mini Golf
- Albany
-Fort Steuben
